content.text: In regions where conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, digital creators face significant barriers. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-selling-beats-online-16|Everything You]]-you-need-20|building]] a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages offers a powerful solution that bypasses these restrictions. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can establish a fully operational online store, leveraging the latest technology to ensure ownership, efficiency, and direct crypto payments. This guide dives into [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-step-step-17|COREMERCH guide to setting]] up your store using Stack 02 in just 48 hours, so you can start selling without the constraints of traditional platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 02 utilizes robust technologies like Cloudflare Pages and Workers, ensuring your store remains operational regardless of external payment platform disruptions. Unlike traditional services that impose restrictions and fees, this architecture provides you with sovereignty over your digital products. With NOWPayments integrated, you gain access to over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing your customers with flexibility in payment options while maintaining low transaction costs.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, ensure you have essential accounts set up. Create a Cloudflare account for hosting your product pages and enable Workers for backend processing. You will also need a Supabase account for managing your product and order data. Familiarize yourself with NOWPayments for managing cryptocurrency transactions. Having these accounts prepped will streamline your deployment process and reduce setup time.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Integrating NOWPayments into your Cloudflare setup is straightforward. Configure the payment webhook to ensure you receive instant notification upon transaction completion. Set up your Supabase database to store order details, and connect it with your product delivery system. Utilize Cloudflare Workers to manage backend logic, enabling seamless file delivery to customers once payment is confirmed. This pipeline guarantees immediate fulfillment of digital products.
You own every aspect of your store with no platform dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is complete, it’s time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site and initiate your first transaction test. Monitor the NOWPayments dashboard for transaction confirmations, ensuring everything operates as planned. Perform end-to-end testing to validate that orders are processed correctly, and customers receive their products without issues. This step is crucial to ensure your customers have a smooth purchasing experience right from the start.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Low fees on transactions keep your profits intact.

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy Stack 02?
Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in just 48 hours. This includes end-to-end testing to ensure your setup is fully operational before you take control.
What are the main advantages of using Cloudflare Pages?
Cloudflare Pages provides fast hosting, scalability, and integrated security features. It allows you to deliver digital products efficiently without the constraints of traditional platforms.
Can I manage multiple products with this setup?
Yes, Stack 02 allows you to manage up to 5 products initially, with options to scale as your business grows. Supabase makes it easy to handle additional items.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving your customers a wide range of options for payment. This flexibility enhances your store's appeal.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, COREMERCH provides 30-day support after deploying Stack 02, ensuring you have assistance as you launch and operate your store.
